## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit subject is `type(scope): summary` ([CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/harshareddy-bathala/Meridian/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] Tests come with the change, and the suites it touches pass
- [ ] A choice someone could have made differently has a `D-` entry in `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- [ ] Anything learned from reading another project is in `ATTRIBUTION.md`, in the same commit
- [ ] Simulated data stays labelled as simulated everywhere this touches
- [ ] No transmit code path, and no external service on the scheduling or reception path
